narrative:
Noble County has 7,823 registered voters, with 19.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 43.0%, a clear Democratic lean of 10.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.7% of registrants.
